# Pafuli Studio

> Pafuli Studio is the games and interactive practice operated by Studio Pafuli Inc. in Montréal. It creates original games and takes on selected game-development collaborations.

Canonical site: https://pafuli.studio/
French site: https://pafuli.studio/fr/
Parent organization: https://pafu.li/

## Original games

- Lock On: an endless-flight game in development. https://pafuli.studio/games/lock-on
- Signal Garden: a working title for a contemplative idle systems game in development. https://pafuli.studio/games/signal-garden

No game platform, store, or release-date information is confirmed unless it appears on the relevant game page.

## Selected collaboration areas

- Game creation and co-development
- Player identity, onboarding, saves, leaderboards, progression data, and lightweight backend systems
- Technical release planning and store or platform preparation for selected projects

Pafuli Studio does not present itself as a separate legal entity from Studio Pafuli Inc.

Public contact: mailto:t@pafuli.studio
